what.text: People in Colombia experienced internal displacement, while others sought refuge or asylum outside the country.
In 2025, IDMC reported 7210702 people living in internal displacement due to conflict or violence.
In the same year, UNHCR reported 7157716 internally displaced people inside Colombia.
Additionally, UNHCR recorded 79669 refugees and 303273 asylum seekers from Colombia in 2025.

why.text: Conflict episodes in Colombia involved the government fighting armed groups including ELN and FARC.
People were forced from their homes by conflict or violence as well as disaster events.
In 2025, IDMC recorded 394106 new conflict-related displacement movements and 88043 new disaster-related displacement movements.

when.text: UNHCR tracked internal displacement in Colombia from 2000 to 2025.
IDMC recorded conflict IDPs from 2009, when there were 4915579 people, reaching 7264767 in 2024.
New disaster movements occurred across multiple years, including 3000000 movements in 2010.

how.text: Internally displaced people stay inside their own country.
UNHCR counts conflict IDPs whom it protects or assists at the end of each year.
IDMC measures both total people displaced at year end and individual movement events during the year.
The sources note that IDMC and UNHCR IDP figures overlap and are counted differently.
